PointsRedeemed(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when points are redeemed by a user

TierChanged(address,uint8,uint8).notice: Emitted when a user's tier changes

balanceOf(address).notice: Returns the current redeemable points balance of a user

earnPoints(address,uint256).notice: Awards points to a user (callable by owner or minter role)

getMultiplier().notice: Returns the current global multiplier (basis points)

setMultiplier(uint256).notice: Sets the global earning multiplier (basis points, 10000 = 1x)

totalPointsEarned(address).notice: Returns the total points earned by a user (lifetime)
